Hi Alex / Priya

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through Atlas Bank's high-level goals this morning. Quick recap and proposal for next steps so we can get a technical deep dive scheduled: 

Recap (from today's discovery)
- Key use case: customer support summarization + sensitive PII redaction for EU/US customers
- Requirement: Private deployment (VPC) with customer-managed networking and KMS integration
- Expected QPS: ~15 requests/sec with spiky daytime traffic; low single-digit latency SLOs for summary endpoint
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 evidence + audit log retention for 12 months

Proposed next step: 60-90 minute architecture review (private/VPC + on-prem options) with our Solutions Engineer + Infra lead. This will cover network/topology, IAM/KMS integration, data flows, and sizing guidance.

Available slots (PT):
- Tue Jun 22 - 10:00-11:00 PT
- Wed Jun 23 - 14:00-15:00 PT
- Thu Jun 24 - 09:00-10:00 PT

Please let me know which slot works best or share alternatives. I've attached the discovery notes from today for reference.

Thanks,
